components.context: The main split in the league: who has the ball and who plays off it.
components.minusText: Handles in pick-and-roll, brings the ball up, dribbles a lot per touch and shoots off the dribble. Typical of point guards.
components.plusText: Catches and shoots or finishes without a dribble, sets screens and goes to the offensive glass. Typical of bigs.

components.context: Among players off the ball, where they operate: outside or inside.
components.minusText: Scores in the paint with layups, floaters and post moves, and spends his off-ball time at the top of the floor as a screener.
components.plusText: Lives beyond the arc, especially in the corners, shoots off the catch or off movement and attacks closeouts.

components.context: How a player gets his points: jump shots in volume, or occasional attacks on the rim.
components.minusText: Takes many shots, with pull-ups, mid-range jumpers and shots coming off off-ball screens.
components.plusText: Shoots little, and mostly layups; his drives end at the rim and he stands still off the ball.

components.context: Players who hunt their own shot on the wing against those who organise from the top.
components.minusText: Stays at the top of the floor, starts possessions, runs pick-and-roll in the middle and shoots off the catch.
components.plusText: Drives from isolation, takes contested shots, gets to the rim and shoots a lot.

components.context: The main split on defense: who protects the paint and who guards the ball.
components.minusText: Guards the ball handlers far from the basket, defends the handler in pick-and-roll and picks the ball up high.
components.plusText: Stays in the paint, is the defender nearest the rim, guards the screeners and goes to the defensive glass.

components.context: Whether a defender's job is to sit in help off a shooter or to be directly involved in the action.
components.minusText: Guards the screener or the ball, moves more and is in the middle of pick-and-roll and off-ball screens.
components.plusText: Assigned to three-point shooters, plays well off his man and spends his time in help position.
